name: ESA / Ontario Electrical Safety Code (CSA C22.1)
description: The Ontario Electrical Safety Code, 29th edition — CSA C22.1:24 Canadian Electrical Code Part I with Ontario Amendments dated November 2024, effective 1 May 2025 — together with the Electrical Safety Authority licensing and notification regime under the Electricity Act, 1998 and O. Reg. 570/05. Two distinct obligation sets travel together and are audited together: the technical code governing installations, and the contractor licensing, notification and inspection regime governing who may perform them and how the work is verified. The 1 May 2025 edition change is recent enough that documents, specifications and estimating templates written against the 28th edition are now out of date.
scope: Electrical contractors and master electricians performing electrical installations in Ontario

families.name: Licensing and Authorization
families.description: Who is permitted to perform and certify electrical work.

controls.name: Electrical Contractor Licence (ECRA/ESA)
controls.description: A current Electrical Contractor Registration Agency licence is held, its number is displayed as required, and renewal is tracked ahead of expiry.

controls.name: Master Electrician of Record
controls.description: A designated Master Electrician is on record for the licence, currently certified, and a named successor arrangement exists so the licence is not exposed to a single departure.

controls.name: Certificate of Qualification and Apprenticeship Ratios
controls.description: Electricians hold a valid Certificate of Qualification for the compulsory trade, apprentices are registered, and journeyperson-to-apprentice ratios are respected on site.

families.name: Notification, Inspection and Code Compliance
families.description: The mechanics of getting work legally verified.

controls.name: Notification of Work to ESA
controls.description: Notification is filed for work requiring it, before the required stage, and the notification number is recorded against the job.

controls.name: Inspection and Certificate of Acceptance
controls.description: Work is presented for inspection, defects are corrected and re-inspected, and the Certificate of Acceptance is obtained and filed with the project record.

controls.name: Current Code Edition in Use
controls.description: The edition in force is identified and used in design, estimating and installation, and the transition from a superseded edition is recorded including any grandfathered work.

controls.name: Contract-Specified Edition Conflict
controls.description: Where a contract or client specification names a superseded code edition, the conflict is recorded and resolved with the client rather than silently resolved in the field.
